note: Hand-kept built years for OSM footprints the assessment roll has no year for (non-residential). Key: OSM id (way/123 or relation/45). Wins over every other source in tools/build_building_tiles.py and tools/died_upper_bounds.py. Fill from data/review_undated_footprints.geojson. `names`: display-name overrides for the hover panel, keyed the same way. `heights`: {osm id: {m, source}} where OSM has no height. `colours`: {osm id: {colour: '#RRGGBB', source}} wall colour where OSM has none. A `names` entry may add periods: [[from, to, name], …] — the earlier names, by year (decimal years ok); name is the current one.
